blocks.raw:
> **Note:**
> The tier downgrade bulk job runs at midnight. For example, if you set the Tier Validity Period to Jan 1, the system will set the expiry to Dec 31 at 23:59:59. To display expiry as Jan 1, set the fixed date to Jan 2.
